verses.text: Hear ye now what the LORD saith; Arise, contend thou before the mountains, and let the hills hear thy voice.

segments.text: Hear ye now what the LORD saith; Arise, contend thou before the mountains, and let the hills hear thy voice.

verses.text: Hear ye, O mountains, the LORD’s controversy, and ye strong foundations of the earth: for the LORD hath a controversy with his people, and he will plead with Israel.

segments.text: Hear ye, O mountains, the LORD’s controversy, and ye strong foundations of the earth: for the LORD hath a controversy with his people, and he will plead with Israel.

verses.text: O my people, what have I done unto thee? and wherein have I wearied thee? testify against me.

segments.text: O my people, what have I done unto thee? and wherein have I wearied thee? testify against me.

verses.text: For I brought thee up out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed thee out of the house of servants; and I sent before thee Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.

segments.text: For I brought thee up out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed thee out of the house of servants; and I sent before thee Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.

verses.text: O my people, remember now what Balak king of Moab consulted, and what Balaam the son of Beor answered him from Shittim unto Gilgal; that ye may know the righteousness of the LORD.

segments.text: O my people, remember now what Balak king of Moab consulted, and what Balaam the son of Beor answered him from Shittim unto Gilgal; that ye may know the righteousness of the LORD.
